definitions.full: H2. ab [ אַב D § 40.4 , אַבָּא Id ib Mei Chr 165 ] noun masculine father (Biblical Hebrew אָב ); — 1 literally father suffix אֲבוּ֫הִי Dan 5:13 (see Behrm Marti), אֲבוךְ (K § 53, 2 a ) 5:11 ; 5:11 ; 5:11 ; 5:18 אֲבוּ֫הִי 5:2 . 2 plural fathers, ancestors , [ אֲבָהָן D l.c. ], suffix אֲבָהָתי Dan 2:33 (Baer תַי -, but see K § 53, 1 ), אֲבָהָתָךְ Ezra 4:15 , תָ֫נָא - (Str. תַ֫נָא —) 5:12 .
